summary: Join our course on Data-Driven Decision Making tailored for government officials. Master the art of using data to inform and improve your decisions.
lede: Data-Driven Decision Making for Government Officials provides a structured way to turn siloed public sector information into actionable policy insights. It supports program evaluation, budget optimization, civic-needs forecasting, and transparent evidence-based interventions. The course builds practical capabilities in data maturity assessment, cross-agency data integration, CRISP-DM, dashboard design, cost-benefit analysis, and policy impact assessment. You will also practice visualization with Power BI or Tableau and develop data governance charters, open data pipelines, citizen sentiment reports, and ethical AI guidelines for public services.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for public sector professionals who are responsible for designing, evaluating, or managing government initiatives and require robust evidence to support their strategic choices.
modules: Public Sector Data Governance and Maturity
Ethical AI and Data Privacy in Government
Open Data Ecosystems and Civic Engagement
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of public administration workflows, departmental reporting structures, and basic policy evaluation concepts. No advanced programming, coding, or deep statistical expertise is required, as the course focuses on the operational application and management of data initiatives rather than technical engineering. Familiarity with standard office software (such as Excel) is expected. We highly recommend participants bring a current policy challenge or an anonymized departmental dataset to apply during the practical workshop sessions.
